findings.claim: The timing sentence still puts setup 'before the day', which the new placement makes untrue for a learner on the documented path and inconsistent with the S13 budget the placement relies on. Line 5 now places the lab on the same day as the review page and the Spring module check (S13), and module.json's captain budget counts the lab as 60 minutes 'setup 5 plus tasks 55' inside S13's 120 minutes, i.e. setup happens in the slot. Line 9 (and lab.json cleanup.notes, 'setup 5 before the day') instead tells the learner setup was due before that day. How a learner reaches it: they first open the README at the lab slot, after the S13 review page; no learner page in the module mentions the lab or its setup (my text scan of all seven artifact.html pages found no 'lab' reference), and nothing in those pages tells the learner to run the lab's setup earlier, so a learner on that path has not done it and reads that they are already behind. The same sentence then says 'If the lab passes 60 minutes', which is the 5 + 55 total, so it is unclear whether the 60-minute stop clock starts at setup or at Task 1. The two readings differ: counted from setup, the stop comes at minute 14 + 60 = 74 and the 45-minute check ends at 119; counted from Task 1 by a learner who set up in the slot, the stop comes at 14 + 5 + 60 = 79 and the check would end at 124, past the fixed 120-minute day, so line 9's 'so the Spring module check still starts on time' does not hold under that reading. Low: the overrun is at most about 5 minutes and only for a learner who also hits the 60-minute stop (likely near the midpoint estimate in cg-education-api-security-007). This is new: no earlier report or the reconciliation mentions 'before the day', and the S13 in-day budget that makes it inconsistent arrived with this change. Placement truth otherwise holds: S13 in the snapshot lists exactly the review page then the Spring module check, the README names no day id, and the snapshot's requiredLab true on S12 is recorded in module.json as routed to the taxonomy owner.

findings.recommendation: Make line 9 say setup is the first 5 minutes of the 60-minute lab slot (or 'before the lab if you can, otherwise at the start of it'), and say the 60-minute stop counts from the start of setup; align lab.json cleanup.notes 'setup 5 before the day' with the same wording in the same change. Alternatively, if setup really should happen before S13, add a one-line pointer where the learner will see it earlier (for example the review page or the S12 OWASP page), which is outside this lab's files.
